description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing 'devices' in a web application using Flask. It includes schema definitions for device data validation, and class-based views for CRUD operations, with detailed request handling and error management.

classes.name: DeviceSchema
classes.description: Schema for a complete device document, used for creation and full replacement.

classes.name: PartialDeviceSchema
classes.description: Schema for partial updates to device documents, all fields optional.

classes.name: ListQuerySchema
classes.description: Schema for query parameters used in listing devices, including filtering, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: DevicesCollection
classes.description: Class-based view handling collection-level endpoints for devices, including POST and GET.

classes.name: DeviceItem
classes.description: Class-based view handling item-level endpoints for individual devices, including GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.

methods.name: validate_name
methods.description: Validator for the 'name' field in DeviceSchema to ensure it is not empty.

methods.name: _parse_sort
methods.description: Parses a sort query string into a list of field-direction tuples for MongoDB.

methods.name: _make_filter_from_query
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB filter dictionary from query parameters.
